paragraphs: Mentioned in Avodah Zarah 28b, teaching Rava several remedies. In Shabbat 133b, Rava expounded the matter in Mechoza, and the sons of Manyomi the physician tore their garments, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כח:/קלג: give Avodah Zarah 28b/Shabbat 133b by convention, without new primary verification. Asya explicitly means physician, not a separate rabbinic title; Rava is an unprefixed name.

מנייהו is complete garments in the tearing idiom, not an untranslatable missing object. Source וכו׳ truncates the continuation only. The sons tear their garments after Rava expounds it in Mechoza; loss-of-livelihood distress is a prior interpretive explanation, not supplied by Hyman or newly verified, and is not inserted into the body.
